ResetRecommended.Hint: Re-apply the recommended Item Piles configuration for Conan 2d20.
ResetRecommended.Label: Open Reset Configuration
ResetRecommended.Name: Reset recommended settings

Notification.ConfigMismatchReapplied: Item Piles: Conan 2d20 detected that Item Piles is not configured correctly and re-applied the recommended defaults.
Notification.ItemPilesNotReady: Item Piles: Conan 2d20 could not find the required Item Piles settings. Make sure Item Piles is active and reload the world.
Notification.ResetComplete: Item Piles: Conan 2d20 recommended configuration has been re-applied.
Notification.SetupFailed: Item Piles: Conan 2d20 v{version} could not apply its recommended configuration. Check the console for details.

ResetDialog.Content: This will re-apply the recommended Item Piles settings for Conan 2d20, including currency, item attributes, filters, and pile actor type.
ResetDialog.SorceryEnabled: Sorcery trade is enabled. Spells and Enchantments are intended to be priced manually per merchant item configuration and will never stack.
ResetDialog.Title: Item Piles: Conan 2d20 | Reset configuration
ResetDialog.Warning: This overwrites your current Item Piles settings.

AllowEnchantmentTrade.Hint: If enabled, Enchantment items can be used in Item Piles trade and merchant flows. Enchantments are treated as non-stackable, and you must set their prices manually in the merchant item configuration.
AllowEnchantmentTrade.Name: Allow trading Enchantments (Alchemy)

AllowSpellTrade.Hint: If enabled, Spell items can be used in Item Piles trade and merchant flows. Spells are treated as non-stackable, and you must set their prices manually in the merchant item configuration.
AllowSpellTrade.Name: Allow trading Spells (Sorcery)

SetupDone.Hint: Internal flag to prevent repeatedly applying the recommended Item Piles configuration.
SetupDone.Name: Setup applied
